title: Pontoon Boat Rentals in Myrtle Beach, SC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the beautiful waters of Murrells Inlet with a pontoon rental—perfect for families and friends looking to enjoy a relaxing day on the water. Choose a 2-, 4-, or 8-hour rental and explore the inlet at your own pace.

Cruise along the scenic waterways, anchor near the Point at Garden City—a popular beach destination primarily accessible by boat—take a swim, or fish the backwaters for flounder, trout, red drum, and more. With room for up to 12 passengers, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Each 22-foot pontoon features comfortable bench seating, a Bimini top for shade, an anchor, required safety equipment, and a full tank of fuel. Before heading out, stop by our on-site Bait Shop for fishing supplies, snacks, beer, cold drinks, and complimentary ice.

Please note, renters be at least 21 years old to rent and present a valid driver’s license for anyone driving.
